content: react-simple-maps 3.0.0 (npm, last published 2023) renders pure-SVG maps via d3-geo (3.1.1) + topojson-client (3.1.0), no tile server at all -- a bundled TopoJSON file (e.g. world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-110m, ~100KB) ships in the JS bundle and renders entirely client-side. Zero runtime network dependency by construction. Library itself is low-churn/stale but its two real engines (d3-geo, topojson-client) are actively maintained; a React-19-compatible fork (react19-simple-maps) exists if peer-dep warnings are an issue.
